[P2] Preserve SDK outcomes when completion reporting fails

If this S3 publication or the following `publish_observation` fails after `invoke()` returns, the surrounding exception handler records `WRAPPER_RAISE` and re-raises the storage error. This discards the SDK response, can trigger an artificial invocation retry, and attributes the failure to the SDK. Separate completion publication from SDK exception classification and contain publication failures as observation errors while preserving the original result or exception. Add a handler-level failing-sink regression; the `ObservedClient` tests do not cover this boundary.
